## [1.2.10](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.9...v1.2.10) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* remove catch-all yMQp6hm patch that crashed with Boolean cast to Runnable; keep only f6olX-specific patches (yMQp6hm=Boolean.TRUE, NMGZ06=Boolean.TRUE, lSqPRgn=true, yMQp6hm field=false) ([39aa0a3](https://github.com/Globberry/morphe-patches/commit/39aa0a3dac78f5d669695d5852287c0e065ca972))

patches.name: PairIP License Check
patches.description: Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.

patches.name: Pro Unlock
patches.description: Forces all Pro features enabled and replaces the Google Play confirmation with a fake success, so ad surfaces never appear.

patches.name: Signer Identity
patches.description: Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate.

patches.name: [ALL] PairIP License Check
patches.description: Neuters PairIP license verification using fingerprint matching (version-robust).

patches.name: [ALL] Pro Unlock
patches.description: Forces all Pro features enabled using fingerprint matching (version-robust for method name changes).

patches.name: [ALL] Signer Identity
patches.description: Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate (fingerprint-based, version-robust).
